fields.title: URSB registry search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures, or _warning if deep pagination was cut short). Each successful record is one matched entity from URSB's public name-search, with upstream's own field names passed through verbatim.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (name or registration number) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-nir-name-search (a matched entity), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed searches -- not_found (search matched nothing) or blocked_or_transient (network issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: pagination_truncated_by_timeout if deeper pages stopped responding before maxResultsPerQuery was reached; the results collected before that point are still included.

id.title: Internal ID
id.description: URSB's internal UUID for this entity record.

ern.title: Entity Registration Number (ERN)
ern.description: URSB's official public registration number for the entity.

subType.title: Entity sub-type
subType.description: e.g. "Private Company Limited by Shares", "Sole Proprietor", "General Partnership".

registrationInstitution.title: Registration institution
registrationInstitution.description: The registering authority (Uganda Registration Services Bureau).

duplicateAllowed.title: Duplicate allowed
duplicateAllowed.description: Whether this name is flagged as allowed to duplicate an existing one on file.

createdAt.title: Created at
createdAt.description: Timestamp the record was created in URSB's system.

deactivatedAt.title: Deactivated at
deactivatedAt.description: Timestamp the entity was deactivated, if applicable.

registrationDate.title: Registration date
registrationDate.description: Date the entity was registered, where on file (often null on this public search -- see README).

affiliations.title: Affiliations
affiliations.description: Any related-entity affiliations on file (empty on every sample seen).

recordStatus.title: Record status
recordStatus.description: Upstream internal record-status tag, where set.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for matched entities and error rows.
